instruction: Access the Huggingface daily paper list and add the titles of 3 additional papers from March 1st, 2024 to the opened .docx document. The document already contains 2 papers. Follow the existing format with 'Title:' prefix for each paper title.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click(640, 400); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding 3 more paper titles to the existing 2, resulting in 5 total titles. The evaluator counts lines starting with 'Title:' in the document. Verified by reading the initial document which contains 2 papers (StarCoder 2 and Beyond Language Models).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts title count by reading docx file and counting lines starting with 'Title:'
Metric logic correctly compares the count using exact integer comparison (result_state == expected_state)
Expected value of 5 is semantically correct (2 existing papers + 3 to be added)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts count -> metric compares -> returns 1.0 on match
Postconfig appropriately saves the file with Ctrl+S before evaluation to ensure changes are persisted
Complete coverage: verifies that exactly 3 papers were added by checking total count equals 5
Edge case handling: getter handles file loading errors and returns 0 on failure
Parameter handling is correct: when expected.type='rule', get_rule returns config['rules'] (5), which is directly passed to metric as expected_state
